1\. Task jobs can time out before finishing 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
plan_run() uses task_job_timeout_minutes(), which budgets only 60 seconds per attempt for work
including the workspace snapshot, although _snapshot_patch() alone can wait up to 600 seconds.
When snapshots take longer than that allowance, the workflow can terminate a valid task job before
it finishes, even though planning approved the suite.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The newly wired planner can approve a suite with a task-job timeout shorter than the time its execution path permits. Its 60-second per-attempt overhead does not cover a workspace snapshot that can take 600 seconds. ## Fix Focus Areas - hb/plan.py[17-32] - hb/plan.py[74-79] - hb/orchestrator.py[85-92] ## Recommended Fix Include the permitted snapshot duration and other bounded per-attempt operations in the timeout calculation. Recheck the hosted-job limit using that bound, and add a test for a suite near the limit. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
